description: List recent transactions for the wallet, newest first. Use this when the agent needs to recall what it has spent recently — for example, before re-charging the same vendor or to summarize spending for a user. Read-only.

limit.description: Max rows to return (1-100). Defaults to 20.

since.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp. Only return transactions created after this time. Useful for incremental syncing.

status.description: Filter by transaction status. 'all' includes both approved and denied charges.

name: list_transactions
